# Rulings — the historical index

**GENERATED by `pnpm governance:compile`. Never hand-edit (RULING 92).**
Governance snapshot `5a0afe21f3ce9176`.

**Sean's standing decisions are [`docs/rulings.md`](../rulings.md)** — the
single source for owner policy since 2026-09-25. `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md`
explain how to apply it. Every ruling indexed here is historical evidence, not
an independently active instruction (`docs/rulings.md` §9).

This index lived at `docs/rulings.md` until 2026-09-25. It is kept, and
generated, so that every `RULING n` reference in this repository and in every
past session report still resolves.

- **The canonical store of these records is `docs/governance/ledger.jsonl`.**
- **Full rationale is `docs/governance/history.md`.**

**This is an index — one line per ruling, not the rulings themselves.** It
once carried every ruling's full body, superseded ones included, which is how
a session came to read a superseded rule here — with nothing making its status
louder than its text — and take dead law for current law. The body now lives
only in `docs/governance/history.md`. Here `Status` is a column of its own, and
`Successor` names the ruling that replaced one that is no longer current.

**Numbering is GLOBAL and IMMUTABLE** (RULING 176). The header this file
carried until 2026-08-26 said numbering was per-brief and that two briefs
could both have a RULING 7. That was already untrue when it was read: the
sequence is unique from 1 through 171, and later collision handling treats
these ids as permanent. An adopted number is never reused and never renumbered.

---

## Un-numbered governance records

**These were never rulings and carry no ruling number.** They are ledger
records that arrived without one — the old constitution's un-numbered rules
(`R-C-*`) and the un-numbered entries of the legacy rulings document
(`R-X-*`): acceptances, recorded measurements, reserved numbers.

**No number is minted for them.** An adopted ruling number is immutable and
is never spent on a record that never had one (RULING 99, RULING 176).

This is an index. The text lives in the policy view named on each row, and
the full body is in `docs/governance/history.md`.
